title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode8 Because You Gave Me Hope

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Because You Gave Me Hope
meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Talking about this is reminding me of everything that happened leading up to my departure from ASRUN...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(No matter how hard I tried...
No matter what I did... Nothing worked...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why...?!
I went to the hospital and even did it just fine during practice...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why won't my legs move when I get on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Are you absolutely sure, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I... I can't be an idol anymore...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Haruka...
It's time for dinner. Won't you come down and join us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, Mom...
I want to be by myself right now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay...
Let me know if you get hungry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I will...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so sorry...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The pain I felt that time was unbearable...
The world even started turning gray...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I... I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
But I'm so glad for you...
You managed to stand back up and become an idol again, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was lucky... Incredibly lucky...
I'm able to stand on stage again because of Minori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also know all too well that not everyone can come back from something like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if I can take away one thing from that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's how your feelings can't be extinguished so easily.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: My feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
In my case, it's my love of being an idol and spreading hope to as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I gave up once and tried to erase that from my mind, but it didn't go away...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My guess is that everyone carries these sorts of feelings, including you, Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Despite all the terrible things that people have said and all that you've gone through, you still want to keep creating music.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Isn't that because you wish to spread hope to everyone more than anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That was when I decided to start making songs that have the power to give all their listeners belief in a “better tomorrow”...!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I was just trying to spread hope with my song, but I ended up hurting these people...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <My mind wants to create, but my hands refuse to do what they're told...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's easy to think that everything would be so much better if these feelings just went away...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Am I right in saying that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But each person has to face up to their feelings in their own way...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some may suffer while dwelling on what's bothering them. Others may find ways to weather the storm while slowly chipping away at their issues.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: How did you face your problems, Kiritani...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! help me deal with that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They taught me that I didn't have to carry all this weight on my own.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to be there for you, Hasegawa, just as MORE MORE JUMP! was there for me.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ultimately, how you deal with this is going to be up to you... But that doesn't mean you have to suffer all alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please ask for help if you ever think you need it. I promise to do everything in my power when you do.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Everything in your power...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For example...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's tickle time...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Eep! H-Haruka...!
Hahahaha...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm doing everything in my power to make you smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Anyway, jokes aside...
I want to help you get through whatever's bothering you, Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So again... Please ask for help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...
You really are an incredible idol, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not saying this as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, we only met just recently and talked mostly about work. Even until just now, we were discussing our new song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we aren't just coworkers or anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Because your music, Hasegawa...
Your songs make us smile, Riho.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a fan of your music, Riho, I want to take this opportunity to give back to you.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I-I'll give it another try...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good.
I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Haruka!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great job.
I didn't catch that entire conversation, but Hasegawa seemed really happy at the end there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Were you able to tell her how you feel, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes...
I told her everything I could.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, all that's left for us to do is give her time and wait.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!
Two weeks later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Today, let's discuss what we'll be doing for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
We need to start by finding a venue and estimating how many people we'll have like last time, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right! It's also gonna be all about singing, so we'll need to think of a good set list to go along with it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. It might be wise to try to get the crowd going with some covers or other songs just in case our original doesn't pan out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How do you think Hasegawa's doing right now...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope she's feeling at least a little better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too...
We haven't heard from her since... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hasegawa?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hasegawa sent us an email!
I-I'm gonna open it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What did she say?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Thank you for what you did the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I've spent a lot of time thinking after you told me your story, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <It became hard to work on my song because I was so scared that it'd end up hurting more people. However...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Even after dwelling on this for so long... I realized that I don't want to stop making my own music.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Again, Haruka, thank you very much.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Some people will keep saying mean things about me, but I want to keep doing everything I can for those who want to support me.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, there's more!
<Lastly, that song's finally complete so I'll be sending it over.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You were all there for me when I needed help, so please accept this as a small token of my appreciation. I hope you all enjoy it.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is what she wrote!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait to hear what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Minori, lay it on us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Coming right up!
Play!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
It tugs at your heartstrings even more now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's as if our individual desires to spread hope to others all came together, including Hasegawa's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! It's all thanks to you, Haruka! I knew you would...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Haruka...!
*Cry*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Geez...
You just can't help it, can you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But...!
I'm really happy that Hasegawa's all better now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And Haruka just showed that she's the best idol ever because she's willing to go through all this trouble for her fans...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we have our new song, it's full steam ahead towards our next show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
Let's make sure to give our best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
Riho's Room

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Oh, everyone from MORE MORE JUMP! replied.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Thank you for this amazing song!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'll have to make my next one just as good!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Thanks to you, Haruka, I already have an idea for my next song. I hope I get a chance to make another song for you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I made so many people sad when I had to leave ASRUN...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even now, that pain still lingers...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But now I know that I can use what I experienced to spread and inspire hope in others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Joy isn't the only thing that has that power. Everything does, including the less-than-enjoyable things in life...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I'm going to keep spreading as much hope as I can!!)
